newsitem.title: THAILAND: ASIAN GAMES SLOGAN DRAWS CRITICISM.
newsitem.headline: ASIAN GAMES SLOGAN DRAWS CRITICISM.

text.p: Organisers of next year's Asian Games in Thailand have upset Olympic officials with their slogan publicising the event.

Sheikh Ahmad Al-Fahad Al-Sabah, chairman of the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA), has asked Games organisers to stop using the slogan "Asian Victory" because it carried implications of racial superiority, a Thai Olympic official said on Thursday.
